title: Don Quixote by Cervantes
text: Don Quixote, written by Miguel de Cervantes and published in two parts (1605 and 1615), is considered the first modern novel and one of the greatest works of fiction ever written. The story follows Alonso Quijano, a man who has read so many chivalric romances that he loses his sanity and believes himself to be a knight-errant named Don Quixote. With his squire Sancho Panza, Don Quixote embarks on adventures, famously mistaking windmills for giants and flocks of sheep for armies. The novel explores themes of illusion versus reality, idealism, and the nature of truth. Its influence on European literature is immense, and it is the second most-translated book after the Bible.
